pr_title: GameEngine: add reproducible local LLM benchmark experiments
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds process-isolated benchmark orchestration on top of the reproducible ADR0142 experiment core. Every planned model/task/repetition run receives a fresh repository-owned fixture copy, a fresh Editor child process, an exact single-model child spec, and a dedicated result file. Parent orchestration records deterministic order, validates child attribution, supports stop-on-failure, and never reuses a private user project.

The remaining slice connects child scenario automation and AI Studio controls for all seven tasks.
